children: Singapore, SG, September 18th, 2026, FinanceWire
New Learn & Earn content breaks down key crypto trading concepts in five-minute lessons, with users eligible to earn up to 2 USDT for completing lessons and quizzes
TetherMax, a crypto trading fee cashback platform, has launched a new
Beginner’s Guide
, a series of educational content designed to help users better understand how cryptocurrency trading works before they trade.

The new educational series focuses on some of the fundamental concepts that new crypto users often encounter, including the differences between cryptocurrency and stock trading, spot and futures trading, and how trading fee cashback works through TetherMax.
Each lesson takes approximately five minutes to complete and is followed by a short quiz, giving users a simple way to check their understanding of the material.
Users who complete eligible educational content and quizzes can also receive rewards of up to
2 USDT
through TetherMax’s Learn & Earn program.
Three Beginner Lessons Cover the Basics of Crypto Trading
The Beginner’s Guide currently consists of three educational modules:
Crypto Trading vs. Stock Trading
Spot Trading vs. Futures Trading
, and
Cashback Basics
The
Crypto Trading vs. Stock Trading

lesson introduces some of the structural differences between cryptocurrency markets and traditional stock markets. It explains topics including 24/7 crypto trading, perpetual futures contracts that do not have a fixed expiration date, and the higher volatility and risks that can come with cryptocurrency trading.
The
Spot Trading vs. Futures Trading
lesson explains the difference between purchasing and holding an underlying crypto asset through the spot market and trading derivatives whose value is linked to the price of an underlying asset.
The lesson also introduces concepts that are particularly important for new futures traders, including
leverage, liquidation risk, and funding fees
, helping users understand both how futures trading works and the risks involved before using these products.
The third lesson,
Cashback Basics
, explains how trading fee cashback works on TetherMax.

The content covers how eligible trading fees can generate cashback through TetherMax’s partnership and referral structures with supported exchanges, as well as differences in cashback rates and withdrawal conditions across exchanges.
Depending on the exchange and applicable conditions, eligible users can receive cashback of
up to 90% of trading fees
through selected TetherMax services.
Learn First, Then Test Your Knowledge
Rather than providing educational content as a standalone resource, TetherMax has connected the Beginner’s Guide with a reward-based learning experience.
Each lesson includes a quiz that allows users to review the key concepts covered in the content. Eligible users who complete the learning activities and quizzes can receive rewards of up to
2 USDT
, subject to the applicable campaign conditions.
The format is designed to make basic trading education easier to access for users who may be unfamiliar with terminology commonly used across cryptocurrency exchanges.

TetherMax said the initiative reflects its focus on helping users understand the mechanics and risks of cryptocurrency trading, rather than approaching trading without a clear understanding of how different products work.

“Crypto markets introduce users to concepts and trading structures that can be very different from traditional financial markets,” said a TetherMax spokesperson. “For new users in particular, understanding the difference between spot and futures trading, how leverage and liquidation work, and how trading fees are calculated is important before they begin trading.”

“With the Beginner’s Guide, we want to make these concepts easier to understand in just a few minutes. We plan to continue expanding our educational content so users can make more informed decisions when using crypto trading products and services.”
TetherMax Combines Trading Fee Cashback With User Education
TetherMax is a crypto trading fee cashback platform that works with more than
16 global cryptocurrency exchanges
, including
Binance, Bybit, Bitget, OKX, and Gate
Through integrations with supported exchanges, TetherMax tracks eligible trading activity and calculates cashback based on trading fees generated by users.

Once an eligible account is connected, cashback is accumulated automatically according to the applicable exchange and account conditions, without requiring users to submit a separate claim after each trade. Users can request withdrawals of accumulated cashback according to the applicable withdrawal requirements.
TetherMax has operated its cashback service for more than four years and currently offers cashback of up to
90% of eligible trading fees
through selected exchange partnerships and programs.

The launch of the Beginner’s Guide adds an educational component to the platform, giving both new and existing users access to short-form learning materials covering the mechanics of crypto trading and trading fee cashback.
Additional educational modules are expected to be introduced as TetherMax expands its learning content.
About TetherMax
TetherMax is a global trading fee cashback platform that enables users to receive back a portion of trading fees generated through eligible trading activity on supported cryptocurrency exchanges.

With more than four years of operating experience, TetherMax works with leading global cryptocurrency exchanges, including Binance, Bybit, Bitget, OKX, Gate, and WOO X Pro. Through exchange integrations, the platform tracks eligible trading activity and calculates cashback based on the applicable conditions of each exchange and account.
Beyond cryptocurrency trading fee cashback, TetherMax is expanding its cashback model into the FX brokerage market as it continues to broaden its services for traders across global markets.
For more information about TetherMax and the Beginner’s Guide, visit the official
TetherMax website
